# Marie Harvey

> Marie Harvey is a dual-threat business owner and mom of seven based in Wichita, Kansas. She runs two businesses solo — Marie Gems, a DTF transfer and custom product shop, and Marie Glow Studio, a web design, Pinterest marketing, and SEO studio.

## Key facts

- Based in Wichita, Kansas
- Mom of seven kids
- Runs both businesses herself — no team, no outsourcing
- Marie Gems: a DTF transfer and custom product shop, three years running, selling across Shopify, Vinted, Whatnot, Etsy, and direct sales
- Marie Glow Studio: a web design, Pinterest marketing, and SEO studio for small businesses (formerly Lavender Pin Co)

## Pages

- [Home](https://marieharvey.com/): overview of both businesses
- [My Story](https://marieharvey.com/about.html): Marie's background, from bullet journals to running two businesses
- [Brands](https://marieharvey.com/brands.html): details on Marie Gems and Marie Glow Studio
